sources.note: m905 Owner's Manual rev E (opened via fetch, PDF text read and the vector panel drawings rendered locally): ACU rear panel drawing (digital version) with 24 numbered callouts, ACU front panel drawing (1 = headphone output TRS 1/4 in, 2 = AC mains standby switch), specification table "Dimensions Main chassis IEC 2U 3.5 in x 10.5 in x 17 in". Rear drawing scale 2.445 px/mm from the 19 in over-ears width (1180 px = 482.6 mm), cross-checked on the 2U height (215 px = 88.9 mm); front drawing 2.49 px/mm. x from the left ear outer edge, y from the bottom edge. Rear drawing is seen from behind (outside of the io face), front drawing from the front.

Grace Design m905 product page (opened): lists main chassis 3.5 in x 10.5 in x 17 in (axes unlabelled). Read as H 3.5 in = 2U 88.9 mm, D 10.5 in = 266.7 mm, 17 in = chassis width without rack ears; with the ears the drawing is 19 in = 482.6 mm wide, so w = 482.6 is used (rack ears included, like the Rio3224-D2 spec).
